gtol_coordinates: optimizer z coordinates; report raw and scaled endpoint gradients
transformation: theta = initial + scale * z, initialized z=0, frozen coordinates unchanged
primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE at termination, with both statuses and full histories. No held-out data.
capacity_gate: Unchanged 90% captured zero-start mean-response energy; eligible termination required.
rationale: Rounded square roots of local chemical-strength-to-threshold/rest curvature ratios from fixed endpoint probes; heuristic family-wide scaling, not a measured Hessian diagonal.
history: Both fresh histories from identical checkpoint; not independent restarts or prior optimizer-state continuation.
failure_policy: Hard budgets and nonfinite retention unchanged; no adaptive budget increases or new dynamics.
timing: Concurrent runs permitted; not controlled wall-time comparison.
